The tail self-cascode is also strengthened: longer top device and lower bottom Vdsat, from a higher gm/Id and more vx. Input gm/Id goes up to free tail headroom."}

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (22.0, 16.0, 26.0),     # diff pair gm/Id
    "Lin":   (4.0, 2.0, 6.0),        # diff pair L
    "gmid_p": (14.0, 10.0, 16.0),    # PMOS load gm/Id (also used by M7, matched Vsg)
    "Lp":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),        # PMOS load L (also M7)
    "Lt":    (2.0, 0.8, 4.0),        # self-cascode top L
    "Itail": (4e-6, 2.5e-6, 5e-6),
    "I7":    (7.5e-6, 5e-6, 9e-6),
    "Cc":    (5e-12, 3e-12, 8e-12),
    "rz_k":  (1.5, 0.8, 3.0),        # Rz = rz_k / gm7
    "gmid_b": (20.0, 14.0, 24.0),    # self-cascode bottom gm/Id
    "vx":    (0.14, 0.10, 0.2),      # self-cascode internal node voltage
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    vdd = 1.8
    Lb, L8 = 4.0, 4.0
    Lt = p["Lt"]
    It, I7, Cc, vx = p["Itail"], p["I7"], p["Cc"], p["vx"]

    # ---- first stage devices
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["Lin"], It / 2, vds=0.5, vsb=0.28)
    vtail = vcm - m1.vgs
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], It / 2, vds=m3_vds if False else 0.8)
    # second stage: scaled copy of M3 so Vsg7 == Vsg3 (d1/o1 balanced)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I7, vds=0.8)
    gm7 = m7.gm
    Rz = p["rz_k"] / gm7

    # ---- bias: self-cascode, gates at ibias node
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], Lb, iref, vds=vx)
    vnb = mb.vgs
    d0 = lut.op("n", 10.0, Lt, vnb - vx, 0.5, vsb=vx)
    Wt = min(4000.0, max(0.42, 10.0 * iref / max(d0["Id"], 1e-15)))
    kt = It / iref
    vds_tt = max(0.05, vtail - vx)
    dtt = lut.op("n", Wt * kt, Lt, vnb - vx, vds_tt, vsb=vx)
    dtb = lut.op("n", mb.W * kt, Lb, vnb, vx)

    # ---- output sink: simple nfet on bias gate
    d8 = lut.op("n", 10.0, L8, vnb, 0.9)
    W8 = max(0.42, 10.0 * I7 / max(d8["Id"], 1e-15))
    d8 = lut.op("n", W8, L8, vnb, 0.9)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("MRT", "ibias", "ibias", "xr", "vss", "nfet", Wt, Lt)
    n.M("MRB", "xr", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", mb.W, Lb)
    n.M("MTT", "tail", "ibias", "xt", "vss", "nfet", max(0.42, Wt * kt), Lt)
    n.M("MTB", "xt", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", max(0.42, mb.W * kt), Lb)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.M("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W8, L8)
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # ---- predictions
    gm1 = m1.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = gm7 / (m7.gds + d8["gds"])
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    CLt = cl + m7.cdd
    p2 = gm7 * Cc / (C1 * CLt + Cc * (C1 + CLt)) / (2 * PI)
    zinv = Cc * (Rz - 1.0 / gm7)
    fz = 1.0 / (2 * PI * zinv) if zinv > 0 else 1e12
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rz * C1)
    pm_mirror = m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg)
    pm = (90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fz))
          - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pm_mirror)))
    Rtail = (1 + dtt["gm"] / max(dtt["gds"], 1e-15)) / max(dtb["gds"], 1e-15)
    cmrr = db(2 * m3.gm * Rtail * A1) - 15            # empirical derating
    slew = 0.8 * min(It / Cc, I7 / (cl + Cc))
    k4 = 4 * 1.380649e-23 * 300.15
    sv = 2 * k4 * 0.7 / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1)
    noise = math.sqrt(sv) * 9.0                        # thermal x flicker allowance (calibrated)
    swing = vdd - m7.vdsat - d8["vdsat"] - 0.05
    power = vdd * (iref + It + I7)
    psrr = db(A1 * A2) - 17
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "cmrr_db": cmrr,
               "slew": slew, "noise_1k": noise, "swing": swing, "power": power,
               "psrr_db": psrr, "polarity": 1}
```
